training.epoch_definition: one pass over the 6,538 training photos (1,635 steps x batch 4); Monet sampled independently with replacement
training.precision_note: bf16 autocast for conv layers; losses, norms and optimizer state in fp32 (1.8x faster than fp32 on RTX 4090, benchmarked)

changes_from_v1: DiffAugment color,translation,cutout on every discriminator input, real and fake (D_B overfit 270 paintings in v1)
discriminator global grad-norm clipping at 15 (v1 collapses followed single D spikes of 21.6-32.6; typical 8-12)
generator upsampling ConvTranspose2d -> nearest x2 + 3x3 conv (checkerboard artifacts in v1)
